description: This Go source file generates provider code for oEmbed providers by processing a JSON file of provider data, filtering for supported providers, converting URL schemes into regex patterns, and executing a template to produce a Go source file.

classes.name: oEmbedProvider
classes.description: Represents an oEmbed provider with its name, URL, and endpoints.

classes.name: oEmbedEndpoint
classes.description: Represents an endpoint for an oEmbed provider, including URL schemes, endpoint URL, discovery flag, and formats.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads provider JSON, filters providers, extracts endpoints, and generates output file.

methods.name: extractEndpointsFromProvider
methods.description: Converts a provider's JSON data into a list of ProviderEndpoint objects with regex patterns.

methods.name: schemeToPattern
methods.description: Converts a URL scheme string into a compiled regex pattern, handling wildcards and protocols.
